answer: A challenge-chain bond stops bulk fakes: identities climb four rings on a spiral ridge, each ring seeded by the prior hash, sealed by a cipher receipt. A quill signature binds each filing; a beacon calls the next ring each epoch; a missed or rented ring burns the bond. k-th 44+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,541,500, lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-link ring fails: its link carries another key. Honest agents pay 44 once and keep the bond.
